name: resizable
useFor: Use for a workspace whose panes people size themselves (the inbox list beside a message, a log beside its detail). Give each ResizablePanel a defaultSize in percent and sensible minSize; add withHandle when the edge needs to be found.
constraints: Panels that can collapse to nothing without a minSize
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the 1px rules between the rails and the inbox list
title: Resizable
description: Panels split by the console's 1px lilac rule, which can be dragged or moved with the arrow keys.
